name: Isaribi Minazuki
source: Mitsuki's only friend and a Catalyst living under the protection of Isaribi, one of the Devil Hunter organizations in Japan.  She is mute, after having witnessed the murder and devouring of her sister by a 'fallen' Hunter.  She is physically weak and vulnerable, just as all of her kind are.  She hates cigarettes with a passion.
